text.title: Agency Risk Register Template — Decision Tree
text.summary: Routing tree mapping observable register signals (row shape, concentration recompute, high-score handling) to a rule from `01-core-rules.xml`. Walk it at every Monday refresh.

decision-tree.root-question: Is this a 3-25 person agency with a client above 20% of revenue or cross-border billing / hiring, and can the founder or PM hold a 30-minute slot every Monday for at least 8 weeks?

conclusion.verdict: do not apply; solo freelancer routes to freelancer-client-scorecard, product team to a project-level register

branch.question: Does the register hold at least one row per agency class (concentration, key-person, FX, contractor classification, pipeline, regulatory), each with all 8 columns, a named human owner and an observable trigger?

conclusion.verdict: reject incomplete rows; fill the six classes with 8-column rows before scoring

branch.question: Was the concentration row recomputed this Monday from the trailing-90-day billing export, and does every client at 40% or more score at least 15?

conclusion.verdict: recompute from billing; auto-score the dominant client at 15 or more

branch.question: Does every row scoring 15 or more carry a dated mitigation action this week or a founder-signed acceptance?

conclusion.verdict: refresh cannot close; assign an action or record a signed acceptance for each row
write the action note, archive resolved rows to the closed tab, close the refresh inside 30 minutes

text.example: 6-person agency, Monday slot held → six classes present, all rows have owner + trigger → concentration recomputed: Client A 47%, scored 20 → Client A row has a dated action (proposal to two new prospects, owner founder, due Friday) → run-the-checklist → refresh closes at 28 minutes.
